changes: The sun is now a world of its own: a volcano world of lava oceans, lava rivers in its rifts and crater lakes in its cones, crusted in basalt and obsidian, different in every world.
The sun's disc in the sky is drawn from that world's surface: bright lava and darker crusts, with the same size, glow and sunlight as before.
Fliers on this version can be captured by the sun and fly away from it as at the moon; older versions fly past it (its sky, spawns and flowing lava come later).
